recommendation: Separately preregister one bounded training-data student-versus-teacher decision deviation diagnostic; the earlier suggested coverage survey was withdrawn as duplicative.
candidate_scope: Select 200 groups from the existing 2253 training groups by a fixed outcome-independent identity rule; bind the cached data and checkpoint identities, read the cache at most once and run at most 200 CPU forwards with a fixed candidate-row cap.
acceptance: Report aggregate teacher-choice rank, top-one agreement and operation-specific counts with explicit missing or invalid cases; stop on identity, input, budget or inference failure and do not resample or retry.
limits: This diagnoses behavior on previously seen training data, not economic causality or independent game performance. Do not use the consumed holdout seeds for tuning or claim new validation.
